module.summary: Integer wrapper constrained to compile-time inclusive bounds.
module.long_description: Integer wrapper constrained to compile-time inclusive bounds.

purpose.primary: Represent a scalar integer that can only contain values within a declared inclusive range.

c_pain.summary: Raw integer fields admit impossible values and spread duplicated range checks throughout a codebase.
c_pain.why_c_is_attractive: A raw integer is simple and efficient.
c_pain.where_c_degrades: The semantic range remains external to the type and every caller must remember it.

zig_response.summary: Encode bounds in a comptime-generated type and reject invalid construction or mutation.
